description: This file contains implementation of fake quantization functions for per-tensor affine quantization in PyTorch's ATen library. It includes functions for forward quantization, caching masks for backward passes, and gradients for learnable quantization parameters.

methods.name: Tensor fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & scale,const Tensor & zero_point,int64_t quant_min,int64_t quant_max)
methods.description: Performs fake quantization on a tensor with specified scale and zero point, returning a quantized tensor.

methods.description: Overloaded: Performs fake quantization using tensor parameters for scale and zero point.

methods.description: Performs fake quantization and returns a mask for the backward pass.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor> _fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine_cachemask_tensor_qparams(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & scale,const Tensor & zero_point,const Tensor & fake_quant_enabled,int64_t quant_min,int64_t quant_max)
methods.description: Performs fake quantization with tensor qparams and returns a mask.

methods.name: Tensor fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine_cachemask_backward(const Tensor & dY,const Tensor & mask)
methods.description: Backward pass for fake quantization with mask, computing input gradients.

methods.name: int64_t _get_zero_point_from_tensor(const Tensor & zero_point,int64_t quant_min,int64_t quant_max,bool is_forward)
methods.description: Extracts an integer zero point from a tensor, with clamping.
